$comment: agentpad13 Rev A - vial-qmk port. Current public board: release/hardware/pcb/v5_7.kicad_pcb (v5_7, md5 08cf68dae979ab28aadd5e0dda34de01). The pin map was re-verified 20/20 GPIO against v5_6; v5_7 changes only the rotations of LED20 and LED21, with zero net, centroid, outline, or pin-map changes. firmware/check_pins_v4.py embeds the definitive GPIO table. firmware/gen_led_layout.py re-derives rgb_matrix.layout from the public board; chain positions 0-12 are SW1-SW13, 13 is the layer indicator, and 14-23 are underglow.
$matrix_comment: Physical GPIO per logical key (definitive table embedded in firmware/check_pins_v4.py): row 0 SW1-SW4 = GP12,GP9,GP5,GP2 | row 1 SW5-SW8 = GP11,GP8,GP4,GP1 | row 2 SW9-SW12 = GP10,GP7,GP3,GP0. Row 3: [3,0]=SW13 2U (GP6), [3,1]=encoder push ENC_SW (GP15), [3,2]=TTP223 touch OUT on GP16 -- null here ON PURPOSE, not unused. R10 straps TOUCH_AHLB->GND on the v5 board, selecting active-high output, so GP16 is polled separately in loudest_micro.c and injected at [3,2]; QMK's global matrix polarity cannot represent it without inverting all 13 switches. [3,3]=genuinely unused. GP18/GP19, GP20, GP28, and the net named GP21 (silicon GPIO24) are DNP J2 spares and deliberately unused.
$joystick_comment: The 512 center and 0..1023 span are the uncalibrated fallback. Hold SW14 for about one second and the on-board routine measures rest/min/max and stores them in EEPROM for the native gamepad and custom arrow/scroll modes; see firmware/BRING-UP.md. JS1 is YTL YA13-FL7.4-B5Ka(45-10)-R-Y06, LCSC C37323742, machine-placed THT. Axis direction is separate from calibration; see firmware/POLARITY-NOTE.md. JOY_X_ADC = GP26/ADC0 and JOY_Y_ADC = GP27/ADC1.
$rgb_comment: GP17 = RGB_MCU -> SN74LVC1T45 level shifter -> 5 V RGB_D00 -> LED1..LED24. max_brightness 105/255 enforces the USB 500 mA budget. firmware/gen_led_layout.py derives isotropic coordinates from the current public v5_7 board: both axes use 64/bbox_height = 0.640 units/mm and x is centered on QMK's default [112,32], producing LED extremes x 88..136 and y 3..62. v5_7 rotates LED20 and LED21 without moving their centroids, so the firmware layout is unchanged.
